title: No asset type is in use
body: Every asset belongs to a type, such as motorcycle or generator. The type decides which meter reading is asked for when fuel is recorded, and the reports add up fuel by type. Use "Set up asset types" above to add one first.

title: Error!
body: Failed to save record due to an error (HTTP 500). Please try again later. Sorry for the inconvenience.

title: Success! Asset has been successfully saved!
Heads up!
body: Please note that you can only see approved fuel records in the reports below.

title: Error 500: Internal Server Error
body: An unexpected exception occurred while fetching data.
